post.author: Christine Gwinnup
post.body:
I am proud as hell 

My brokerage chose me to speak as one of four panelists in front of the best of the best Colorado Agents yesterday explaining my growth as a Realtor over the last two years.

I sold 12 homes my first year and closed on my 28th home in my second year. I caught my wonderful Broker's eyes and Duff Knott and Liz Cannon Montoya trusted me with a microphone! They are the people that brought a great group of agents together and call them family. Realty ONE Group

I have to give special thanks to Yadi Rodriguez Robles, you truly know how to be a friend. You helped me focus on the blessings God has in store for me. Ashley Stallings, you helped me relax and enjoy the moment. I just had to look at you while I was up on that chair and know you had my back. Christy Perkins, thank you for sending me the picture and words of encouragement last night. You are courageous, beautiful and well, perfect. Nicholas Newsom, not sure you realized it but when I saw you in the crowd, your smile and nod kept me going. And as always, Natalee Newsom, you are my model, and I owe my success to the mentors like you that believed in me.

Love you all - and I am so very thankful for being part of the ROG Family - I found my home by helping others find theirs.
